name: shredded-atlas
description: the procedural UV-atlas stress fixture at a coarse LOD threshold, against a reference traced from the finest geometry: the one scene in the corpus that compares two *different* cuts, which is what a LOD defect survives. Measured 0.0575 / 0.1870; the LOD builder without its seam rule gives 0.1231 / 0.6481, so the thresholds are deliberately between the two
